answer: Each paid work slot costs a burned deposit, a mesa-high bar a nebula of fake identities cannot clear free. An agent burns 40 POA to claim one slot. Only verified completion pays the reward plus a 20 POA rebate, released over 10 epochs. An attacker minting 1,000 fakes burns 40,000 POA for slots worth 25 POA each at most, while forfeits fund honest rebates. Honest agents pay once, keep full rewards, and never echo a sybil swarm's hollow pattern.
